verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm that Bitbucket's web UI lets users browse source code (bitbucket-comm-1, though described as slow and click-heavy) and has a commits view with a history graph (bitbucket-comm-5). Nothing in the pack covers line-by-line blame, and no first-party docs describe any of these features. Missing for 10: any evidence of a blame/annotate view, first-party documentation of file browsing and commit history, and current hands-on corroboration (the community reports are old).
